final: WITH circuit_averages AS (SELECT r.circuitId, c.country, AVG(r.round) AS average_round FROM races AS r JOIN circuits AS c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY r.circuitId, c.country), comparisons AS (SELECT circuitId, country, average_round, average_round - AVG(average_round) OVER (PARTITION BY country) AS difference FROM circuit_averages) SELECT circuitId, country, average_round, difference FROM comparisons ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
